scenario: Mountkirk Games needs a globally distributed relational database with multi-region synchronous writes and ACID consistency for player state.
criteria: Must recommend Cloud Spanner due to global synchronous multi-region ACID write transactions.

scenario: An enterprise with 15 projects requires a single private corporate IP address space, centralized firewall rules, and hybrid on-prem connectivity.
criteria: Must recommend Shared VPC with a host project and service projects for centralized network governance.

scenario: EHR Healthcare must prevent data exfiltration from Cloud Storage and BigQuery even if authorized user credentials are used outside trusted networks.
criteria: Must recommend VPC Service Controls security perimeters to isolate Google Cloud APIs from unauthorized network perimeters.

scenario: Automate progressive canary deployments (10% traffic shifts) with built-in verification and automated rollbacks on GKE.
criteria: Must recommend Cloud Deploy for declarative multi-target delivery pipelines with canary support.

scenario: TerramEarth needs to ingest sensor metrics from 5 million cellular-connected machines buffering millions of events per second with autoscaling.
criteria: Must recommend Pub/Sub streaming buffer decoupled with Cloud Dataflow stream processing.

scenario: An application on Cloud Run experiences intermittent 504 gateway timeouts across microservices; engineers need to find the slowest RPC call.
criteria: Must recommend Cloud Trace for distributed latency tracing across microservices.
